product_summary: Vasa Denticity Limited (CIN L74999DL2016PLC305052, NSE Emerge: DENTALKART) operates Dentalkart.com, an online dental B2B/B2C store. Site states 20,000+ SKUs from 450+ brands. Real product lines listed on the homepage and About page: dental chairs, airotors, scalers, compressors, apex locators, X-ray machines, autoclaves, intra-oral cameras, endomotors, implant prosthetics, rotary files, composites, glass-ionomer cements, sealers, impression materials, dental plaster/stone, wax, adhesives, disinfectants/sterilising agents, brackets (orthodontics), sutures & needles, abrasives, hand/surgical/diagnostic instruments, dental burs, PPE kits and gloves. Own brand 'Waldent' (via wholly-owned Waldent Innovations Pvt Ltd) plus distribution of Dentsply Sirona, NSK, GC, 3M ESPE, Woodpecker, Septodont, Coltene, Prevest Denpro, AlChem, Endoking, SuperEndo, U Orthodontics.
role_hint: trader (distributor/e-commerce reseller) with own private-label brand; no manufacturing plant evidenced on site — Waldent-branded goods are sourced/rebranded. Trader status is not a rejection ground per project rules.
comment: HS 9018.41 (dental drill engines) is CORRECT but covers only a small slice of the catalogue — status partial, code kept and expanded, not rejected (Rule 3). Actual mapping: 9018.41 airotors/dental drill engines; 9018.49 other dental drill engines/handpieces; 9018.39 dental chairs and parts (chairs are a headline category); 9018.11/9018.19 dental X-ray and other electro-diagnostic apparatus (apex locators, intra-oral cameras); 9018.20 sterilizers/autoclaves; 9018.31/9018.32 syringes and needles (sutures & needles line); 9018.50 other dental instruments and appliances (hand/surgical instruments, scalers, burs, orthodontic brackets); 9018.90 parts and accessories (spare parts category); 3006.40 dental cements and other dental fillings, 3006.50 dental impression materials, 3006.60 dental waxes; 3407.00 modelling pastes/dental plaster and stone; 3824.99 chemical preparations (disinfectants/sterilising agents, etchants, bonding agents — some may fall under 3808/3506 depending on composition); 8207.90 interchangeable tools (rotary files/burs where not classed as dental instruments); 9017.20/9402.10-9402.90 for measuring instruments and dental/medical furniture where applicable; 8419.20 for sterilising apparatus if not 9018.20. INDUSTRY MISCLASSIFICATION: declared industry 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is wrong — the company is a dental supplies distributor/e-commerce; only the small dental-materials slice (cements, impression materials, waxes, disinfectants) touches Chapter 30/34/38. TRADER SIGNS: 450+ third-party brands, 'direct authorisation letters', 4 warehouses, no factory/plant mentioned anywhere on site — reseller model. PRODUCT LINES MISSING FROM DECLARATION: dental chairs and furniture, autoclaves/sterilisers, X-ray and imaging equipment, orthodontic brackets, sutures/needles, PPE and gloves, burs and abrasives, spare parts. All product claims above are from the company's own website (dentalkart.com homepage and /about-us, accessed for this review) — no customs line or shipping bill was examined in this task, therefore every product line is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' at the shipment level; the product range itself is corroborated by the live catalogue structure, but export/domestic supply factuality was out of scope here.
